mode_selection: Completed pair first, then fewer disqualifying material inventions/contradictions, then full facts, then generation latency. If no mode completes both, off for bounded diagnostic, not claimed semantic winner.
judgments: implementation-author; not independent; full facts and selected-path facts separate; no percentages
promotion: latest positive and benign must jointly pass strict rubric; ledger activation also needs paired SOC/risk control fidelity; otherwise current defaults unchanged/Aster NOT RUN
aster: Inherited bytes, runtime, 12-order, compact/ledgerON/default think and180s retained; test-proven process-local isolation only; never run old runner unconfigured
stop: Any UNKNOWN/incomplete attempt stops further inference; no health/time-only recovery, no provider restart, no hidden retry.
